notes.title: TWO AWARDS WE’ll NEVER FORGET
notes.content:
The Night is Grey has won AGOTY’s Best Screenplay as well as Best Visual Art & Animations.

All those years ago when we started our first game ever, with no background experience, we made all the rookie mistakes. Including having our first game be very ambitious, complex and challenging with equally challenging subjects. 

Often times, after 7 years of developing this in our spare times, we remarked with each other it was almost a miracle we stuck to it for so long and actually finished it despite many personal setbacks. So imagine how we feel to have this kind of recognition, because we have no words to properly convey it.

Thank you to everyone that believed in us and helped us along the way. Here’s hoping we keep surprising you in the future.

We just updated the games's build into 1.2 that improves and adds the following:

•  Added a trigger warning disclaimer in the games start loading screen.
•  Added a small reminder tutorial in Ch2
•  Added a brand new music during a cutscene
•  Game start load time improvement
•  Some corrections on the dialogues
•  Readjusted the mine map visibility
•  Fixed hints spots not showing outside the office in Ch2
•  Fixed a small visual bug in the mine

Just make sure that you have the minimum required specs
to run the game mentioned the steam game page store.

We are still improving the game's build.

Thank you for the support,
Whalestork team.

notes.title: THE NIGHT IS GREY - DEMO UPDATE V1.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37301806/421134eba8b3bc3320a0fe256454ba0d0ef66cca.gif

The wolves are listening, and to prove so, here's our first demo update with a good range of fixes, optimizations and new gameplay elements.


 Added 2 new unique Graham animations
 Graham now checks his smokes & has a new conversational animation


 Added a ingame tutorial
The context based tutorial explains where's the inventory and that you can use items on the characters


 Added right click to fast travel to locations
You can now right click to fast travel between locations


 Added more unique item/dialogue interactions
 Implemented Graham reacts with new dialogue prompts for various items/hotspots


 Graham walk speed up 40%
 We heard, and Graham walks faster into danger.


 Text speed up 20%
 A little tweak to make reading more organic


 Game menu loads faster
 No explanation needed here


 Fixed 3 hotspots location range
 The hotspots for the notepad,  generator lid, and house pathway have been adjusted


 Hotspot indicator more evident
 The mouse cursor now indicates more evidently when you hover on a hotspot


 Improved overall game speed
 Various tweak to make the game play faster, including scene transitions.


 Various visual & sound tweaks
 Added new and previously missing sounds. Leveled various sounds to match the scene.


Thank you for your feedback & support, enjoy our demo. 
If you stream our demo feel free to give us a shoutout, maybe we'll meet you there.

Follow us on twitter
Join our Discord
